title: Exploring Conversational Agents as an Effective Tool for Measuring Cognitive Biases in Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Using a task-oriented conversational agent in a trip-planning scenario to present decision tasks using intensifying adjectives and phrases versus neutral facts, and analyzing user choices between an experimental and control group.

Deploying a chatbot to offer trip-planning options involving different product choices and prices, and statistically evaluating whether users demonstrate a tendency to prefer avoiding losses over acquiring equivalent gains.
